book_subtitle: Hands-on companion notebooks for the three-volume textbook series

notebooks.title: Data Quality Assessment
notebooks.question: How do you tell whether a clinical dataset is fit for modelling before you train anything?
concepts: Assess data completeness, consistency, and validity
Detect outliers and anomalous values
Generate comprehensive data quality reports
Visualize data quality issues systematically

notebooks.title: Missing Data Handling

concepts: Understand different missing data mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, MNAR)
Implement various imputation strategies
Compare the impact of imputation methods on model performance
Visualize missing data patterns

notebooks.title: Feature Engineering

Engineer temporal features from time series data

Implement domain-specific transformations

notebooks.title: Cross-Validation Strategies

Use stratified CV for class-imbalanced datasets
Apply temporal CV for time series data
Design grouped CV for patient-level splitting

notebooks.title: Data Leakage Detection

Detect target leakage and temporal leakage

Quantify the impact of leakage on model performance

notebooks.title: Classification Metrics
